title: Why your bathroom outlet has two buttons

scenes.text: Why does your bathroom outlet have two little buttons? It’s a GFCI, and it’s watching.
scenes.voice: Why does your bathroom outlet have two little buttons? It's called a G F C I, and it's watching.

scenes.text: Electricity flows out on one wire and back on the other. The two should always match.
scenes.voice: Electricity flows out on one wire, and back on the other. The two should always match.

scenes.text: If some goes missing, it’s leaking somewhere it shouldn’t. Through water. Or through you.
scenes.voice: If some goes missing, it's leaking somewhere it shouldn't. Through water. Or through you.

scenes.text: So it cuts the power in a fraction of a second.
scenes.voice: So it cuts the power, in a fraction of a second.

scenes.text: One GFCI can protect several outlets, sometimes in a different room. So a dead outlet is usually not broken.
scenes.voice: One G F C I can protect several outlets, sometimes in a different room. So a dead outlet is usually not broken.

scenes.text: Find the one with the buttons, and press “Reset.”
scenes.voice: Find the one with the buttons, and press reset.
